title: Ex15 - Code: Violin and box plot iris
text: Using the iris dataset (dfIris), plot a violin plot and a box plot side by side in one figure. Both plots show variety on the x-axis and sepal.width on the y-axis.
answer:
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1,2)
sns.violinplot(x='variety', y='sepal.width', data=dfIris, ax=axes[0])
sns.boxplot(x='variety', y='sepal.width', data=dfIris, ax=axes[1])
